metabolic_screening.program_name: Louisiana Newborn Screening Program (LA DHH Bureau of Family Health)

out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Out-of-hospital providers (midwives, physicians) order newborn screening collection cards through the LA Department of Health Bureau of Family Health / State Public Health Laboratory. Supplies are requested via the LDH Newborn Screening supply ordering process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24-48 hours of age; repeat screen required if first collected before 24 hours.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the ordering provider; parents receive results from their provider. Tracking via the LDH Newborn Screening portal.

hearing_screening.program_name: Louisiana Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife performs or arranges the newborn hearing screen and documents results; refusal is documented in writing in the medical record per La. Rev. Stat. 40:1242.1.
hearing_screening.statute: La. Rev. Stat. Ann. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 40:1242.1 (includes hearing screening); LA EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented per La. Rev. Stat. 40:1242.1.
cchd_screening.statute: La. Rev. Stat. Ann. ÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ§ 40:1242.1 (critical congenital heart defect screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.statute: La. Admin. Code Title 51 ÃÂÃÂ§ II-301 (Prevention of Blindness)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: Prophylactic eye treatment (0.5% erythromycin) is required under the Prevention of Blindness rule; a parent may refuse on religious grounds and the refusal is documented in the medical record. Louisiana issues no separate standalone waiver form beyond documented informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Approved prophylactic applied to each eye shortly after birth to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum.

vitamin_k.note: Louisiana does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to LINKS by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Louisiana provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
